verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents 30 idiomatic SDKs: 13 client-side, 13 server-side and 4 edge, including a Cloudflare edge SDK. Community users confirm a mobile client SDK exists and describe a common client model where SDKs download all flags on connection and then stream changes. OpenFeature providers and the Relay Proxy round out multi-stack delivery. missing for 10: an explicit per-platform SDK list naming web and mobile targets, documentation guaranteeing consistent evaluation semantics across SDKs, and hands-on corroboration of cross-stack consistency.
